name: Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio
summary: High-end German open-top sports roadster engineered for blistering coastal cornering along Ocean Drive and luxury boulevard cruising.
description: The Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio represents contemporary Vice City wealth. Modeled after the modern Porsche 911 Cabriolet, its rear-engine twin-turbo configuration delivers instantaneous acceleration, precision traction, and a retractable fabric soft-top designed for sunny Leonida beach weather.

seo.title: Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio: Specs, Top Speed & Customization
seo.description: Full guide to the Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio in GTA VI. Specs, convertible top controls, top speed benchmarks, and Ocean Drive spawns.
